t: You're looking at the Church of Our Most Holy Redeemer and St Thomas More, usually called Holy Redeemer Church. It's a Roman Catholic parish church on the corner of Upper Cheyne Row and Cheyne Row, right next to Carlyle's House. It opened on 23 October 1895 and is Grade II listed. The architect was Edward Goldie, who lived from 1856 to 1921. He specialised in Roman Catholic churches, mostly in Gothic Revival style, and he was the son of another architect, George Goldie. Look for that Gothic Revival character in the building in front of you.
